sanskrit:
यथाऽऽकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान्।
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय।।
image_english: Understand that as the mighty wind, blowing everywhere, rests always in the sky, all created beings rest in Me.
caption:
Chapter 9, Verse 6

Kṛṣṇa gives the Air analogy. ‘yathākāśa-sthito nityaṁ vāyuḥ sarvatra-go mahān’ (Understand that as the mighty wind, blowing everywhere, rests always in the sky). ‘tathā sarvāni bhūtāni mat-sthānīty upadhāraya’ (All created beings rest in Me). The wind blows violently, but it cannot blow outside the sky. It is contained within the sky. Similarly, all the chaotic movements of the universe—stars exploding, galaxies colliding—happen *within* Kṛṣṇa. Nothing is outside His jurisdiction.
